text:
anya: Quick post from today's perf run. We enabled the int4-speed profile on parabank-v5 (candidate inline) and saw a sharp drop in paraphrase recall on the short-anchor slice (~21%). Throughput good, but quality hit is non-trivial. Fail list: s3://redwood-curation/parabank/v5/fails/6876543210.txt :unamused:

devon: Oof. Any quick stats? identical_prefix_frac or first-n-token collisions?

anya: I added a tiny eval metric: identical_first_7_tokens = 0.31 (baseline 0.06). Also saw many cases where different paraphrases map to identical first-8 token sequence after quant run.

meera: Could be rounding + token compacting in the quant kernel. Before we block the profile, can we run two short checks: 1) FP16 fallback, 2) dedupe at fuzz 0.83 to see dataset contribution?

anya: Running dedupe now. Command: `curate dedupe --manifest s3://redwood-curation/parabank/v5/manifest.json --fuzz 0.83 --out s3://tmp/parabank-v5/dedup-0.83.json --keep 4500`

labelops_bot: Label queue created: queue_id=lab-q-2026-03-27-09, size=712, sampler=paraphrase-fuzz-0.83, priority=high

devon: I'll kick off an eval run with FP16 fallback and KV debug: `./eval_run --model candidate:q4b-speed --prompts s3://redwood-curation/parabank/v5/manifest.json --kv-debug --fallback fp16 --out ./runs/candidate-q4b-fp16-6876543210.json`

meera: If FP16 fixes it, sounds like a kernel rounding issue. If so we should try a canary with `--quant-stable-enc` flag before expanding golden set. Runtime team, can we get a canary?

runtime-ci: We have a canary build with `--quant-stable-enc` ready (id canary-2026-03-27-c3). We can run it in a 1hr window. If traces align with FP16 we can plan a patch.

devon: FP16 fallback finished. Paraphrase recall restored to within 2% of baseline. Traces uploaded: s3://redwood-runs/candidate/q4b/fp16-debug-6876543210.json. KV traces show repeated prefixes only on int4 run.

anya: That indicates quant path is normalizing some encodings. Meera, go ahead and open a small relabel + synthetic augment plan in parallel. We don't want to rely solely on kernel patch for safety.

meera: On it. I'll create a micro-label batch limited to short anchors and mark "preserve-canonical" where appropriate. Capacity ~500/day in compact UI. I'll also generate 180 synthetic early-token perturbations and reserve 120 slots in golden review.

labelops_bot: Queue update: shard1=180 assigned, shard2..4 pending. Progress URL: https://labels.redwood/queues/lab-q-2026-03-27-09

anya: Block auto-rollout of the q4b-speed profile for now. If runtime canary matches FP16, we'll schedule a kernel patch; otherwise proceed with relabel + synthetic anchors and rerun full regression.
devon: FYI I'll add a console metric `frac_identical_kv_prefix_first12` so future runs show a trendline. Also adding a small smoke test that computes fraction_of_identical_first_8_tokens per profile.

runtime-ci: Canary run scheduled now with `--quant-stable-enc`. Will report differences vs fp16 and int4 baseline within the hour.

meera: First shard started. ETA update in 8hrs. I'll tag ambiguous merges as `needs-panel` so golden can adjudicate.

anya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after canary + first shard results.
